streamer.title: Streamer mode
streamer.text: Hides emails, Riot IDs, detailed ranks and shops everywhere in the app.

offline.active: You appear offline to your friends
offline.notifyBody: {game} is starting. You appear offline to your friends.

play.sessionExpired: Session expired for {name}: sign in in the Riot window, the game will launch automatically.
play.captchaHint: Solve the verification in the window that opened.

hero.resume: Pick up where you left off

accounts.addLoginHint: Opens the official Riot Client sign-in (2FA supported)
accounts.addCurrentHint: Captures the account currently signed in to the Riot Client
accounts.addManualHint: Create the card now, sign in later
accounts.no2faHint: Enable two-factor authentication on this Riot account
accounts.refreshSessionHint: Account must be signed in to the Riot Client
accounts.emptyText: Add a Riot account to switch and launch LoL, TFT or VALORANT in two clicks.
accounts.deleteText: Delete "{name}" from RiftSwitch? Its encrypted session will be erased. Your Riot account itself is not affected.

editor.valRankHint: VALORANT ranks are not readable locally: enter yours here.
editor.securityNote: These fields are encrypted in your vault and never displayed again. RiftSwitch only shows whether they are set.
editor.passwordHint: Used to sign you in to this account automatically when you switch — stored encrypted, like a password manager, and sent only to Riot. Leave empty to sign in manually instead.
editor.twoFa: Two-factor authentication enabled on this account
editor.twoFaReminder: Tip: enable 2FA in your Riot account settings.
editor.loginReady: One-click switching is enabled for this account.
editor.loginNeeded: Add username and password to switch to this account in one click.

icon.importHint: Import an image: you can then move and zoom it inside a circle.
icon.legal: Champion artwork © Riot Games, used under the Legal Jibber Jabber policy.
icon.autoHint: Auto: uses your LoL summoner icon, fetched when you launch the game.

login.title: Sign in with Riot
login.waiting: Waiting for you in the Riot Client…
login.step1: The official Riot Client sign-in window opens.
login.step2: Sign in to the account (2FA handled in the app).
login.step3: RiftSwitch detects the account and saves it, encrypted.
login.staySignedIn: Signed in, but "Stay signed in" seems unchecked: sign out and sign in again with the box ticked.
login.privacy: Your credentials are typed in Riot's window, never in RiftSwitch.

tonight.title: Which account tonight?
tonight.subtitle: Pick a goal: RiftSwitch suggests the best account and explains why.
tonight.goal_role_text: An account where that role isn't your main
tonight.goal_friends_text: The account closest to their rank

configs.subtitle: Keybinds, HUD, sound and graphics profiles, shareable and applied per account.
configs.howLol: Applied through the League client when it's open (saved to the signed-in account), otherwise to the local files. Profiles linked to an account are re-applied automatically after it signs in.
configs.howVal: VALORANT stores settings on Riot's servers: RiftSwitch copies the local files of each account (BackupKeybinds, settings). Results may vary.
configs.empty: No profile yet. Capture your current config to start.
configs.noCategory: Enable Interface, Sound or Graphics to edit these settings.
configs.captureLolHint: If the League client is open and signed in, the account's synced settings are captured. Otherwise the files in the Config folder are read.
configs.captureValHint: Choose the VALORANT account folder to copy (one per account that played on this PC).
configs.name: Profile name
configs.noValDirs: No VALORANT config found on this PC.
configs.appliedClient: Applied and synced to the signed-in account
configs.appliedFiles: Applied to local files. Linked accounts get it again after signing in.
configs.assignHint: Linked accounts receive this profile automatically at launch. Tick them all for a new season.
configs.valWarn: Close VALORANT first. The game may restore its server settings.
configs.deleteText: Delete "{name}"? Accounts using it will be unlinked.

kb.quickHint: Enable quick cast (smart cast) per ability or item.
kb.valHint: Custom VALORANT bindings for this profile. Click a key to change it.
kb.valParseError: This VALORANT keybind file could not be read.

keys.conflict: This key is used by several actions

runes.subtitle: Save rune pages, share them with a short code and send them to any account.
runes.clientClosed: Open the League client (signed in) to read and send rune pages.
runes.emptyLibrary: Save pages from the client or import a code.
runes.pushed: Page sent to the League client

shops.subtitle: Store previews, inside the app only.
shops.lolText: The rotating shop is the same for every player and changes every 14 days (prestige and Hextech skins, rare icons and chromas). Preview with countdown coming soon.
shops.valText: Your daily VALORANT offers and Night Market, per account.
shops.valWarn: Reading the VALORANT store uses non-public Riot endpoints with your account token: this may go against Riot's terms. Opt-in only.
shops.streamerHidden: Shops are hidden in streamer mode.

patches.subtitle: Latest patches for LoL, TFT and VALORANT.
patches.tftText: Teamfight Tactics patch notes and set changes.
patches.valText: VALORANT patch notes: agents, weapons and maps.
patches.recapText: A short summary of buffs and nerfs for each patch, right in the app.

esport.subtitle: Today's matches, results and leagues you follow.
esport.soonText: Today's matches and results will appear here. Meanwhile, open the official sites.

achievements.subtitle: Cross-account challenges that earn shards to unlock app themes.
achievements.noMoney: Shards are earned through achievements only. No real-money purchases, ever.

settings.themeShards: Extra themes unlock with shards earned in Achievements ({n} ✦).
settings.closeToTrayText: Closing the window keeps RiftSwitch in the notification area, using almost no resources.
settings.startMinimizedText: Start directly in the notification area.
settings.playLabelsText: Show the game name under each icon.
settings.performanceText: Turns off blur and animations. Auto: on for small PCs or on battery.
settings.zoomText: On top of the Windows / macOS scaling.
settings.vaultOs: No master password: key protected by Windows / macOS for your session.
settings.removePassword: Remove the master password (key protected by the OS)
settings.lockOnSleepText: Lock when the computer wakes up from sleep.
settings.threatText: Malware already running on your session (keylogger, injection, memory reading) can capture your master password or secrets while you use them. No local manager can prevent that, and the same is true of the Riot Client itself. RiftSwitch reduces the exposure window (auto-lock, short-lived secrets, memory wiping) but cannot remove it.
settings.blockInGameText: Refuse to switch accounts while a game is running.
settings.autoProfilesText: Each account receives its linked LoL / VALORANT profile.
settings.notDetected: Not found: enter the path to RiotClientServices.
settings.discordText: Show your game on Discord (Riot ID optional, turned off in offline mode).
settings.quitRiotText: Close the Riot Client and the games (refused during a game).
settings.telemetryText: Off by default. Account bucket, launches and rounded hours, version, OS. Never an email, Riot ID or game data.
settings.previewText: Exactly what would be sent, at most once a day, if you turn statistics on:
settings.valStoreText: Reads your offers with your account token through non-public endpoints.
settings.thirdPartyText: Complements ranks when the client is closed.
settings.backupText: Export your whole vault (accounts and sessions) to a file encrypted with a dedicated passphrase, or import a backup. Never in clear text.
settings.resetText: Erases everything: vault, sessions, profiles, cache, preferences and the key stored by the OS. RiftSwitch returns to first launch.
settings.resetConfirm2: Last confirmation: this cannot be undone.
settings.closeRiotClient: Close the Riot Client after launch
settings.closeRiotClientText: Once the game is open, its window is closed like with the X button. The client keeps running in the background.

setup.tagline: Your Riot accounts, ready to play in two clicks.
setup.securityText: Your sessions are always encrypted on this PC. Choose how the key is protected.
setup.withPasswordText: Asked when RiftSwitch starts. Never stored, never sent.
setup.withoutPasswordText: The key is protected by Windows / macOS for your session.
setup.portableNeedsPassword: The portable version requires a master password.
setup.passwordNote: If you forget it, the vault cannot be recovered: you'll have to reset the app and add your accounts again.
setup.osWarning: Anyone with access to your Windows / macOS session will be able to use your accounts.
setup.ackRequired: Please confirm you understand the risk.
setup.privacyText: RiftSwitch works fully offline from our servers.
setup.privacy1: Your credentials and sessions never leave this PC.
setup.privacy2: Statistics are anonymous, opt-in and can be withdrawn in one click.
setup.privacy3: Only one system notification: the offline-mode confirmation.
setup.accountText: You can also do this later from the Accounts page.

unlock.forgotText: The master password cannot be recovered: it is never stored. You can reset RiftSwitch (all saved accounts will be erased) and start again.

about.legal: RiftSwitch isn't endorsed by Riot Games and doesn't reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.
about.vanguard: RiftSwitch never reads or writes game memory, injects code or automates in-game input: it only acts before launch, through Riot Client files and the local APIs meant for clients.

errors.vault_corrupt: The vault file is damaged. A backup (.bak) is kept next to it.
errors.vault_tampered: The vault was modified outside RiftSwitch and was refused.
errors.portable_needs_password: The portable version requires a master password.
errors.os_keystore: The Windows / macOS key store is unavailable.
errors.riot_not_found: Riot Client not found. Set its path in Settings › Riot & games.
errors.game_in_progress: A game is in progress: finish it before switching accounts.
errors.no_session: No saved session for this account: use "Sign in again".
errors.no_session_file: No Riot Client session found on this PC.
errors.not_signed_in: The Riot Client isn't signed in with "Stay signed in" checked.
errors.identity_mismatch: The account signed in to the Riot Client isn't this one.
errors.import_invalid: This file isn't a valid RiftSwitch export.
errors.lol_not_found: League of Legends install not found.
errors.local_api: The Riot local API didn't answer.
errors.offline_no_target: Offline mode: chat server not received yet.
errors.login_failed: Sign-in failed (wrong credentials or locked account).
errors.captcha: The verification could not be completed.
errors.captcha_unsupported: The verification window is only available on Windows.
errors.redeem: The Riot Client refused the sign-in.
errors.redeem_failed: The Riot Client did not accept the sign-in in time.
errors.captcha_failed: Riot keeps asking for verification. Try again in a few minutes.

mfa.title: Two-factor code
mfa.text: Enter the code sent to {email} to finish signing in.

add.title: New account
add.loginHint: Riot username and password, stored encrypted and sent only to Riot — used to switch to this account in one click.
add.needCreds: Enter the Riot username and password.
add.tagsPh: Press Enter to add a tag
add.emailHint: Optional, just a note — not used to sign in.
add.langsHint: Game language per game for this account (e.g. VALORANT in Japanese, LoL in English).

update.text: Signed update, installs in a few seconds.
update.autoText: New versions install at startup, with no action needed. Only contacts github.com; each package is verified with RiftSwitch’s signature.
update.screenText: RiftSwitch {v} is installing and will restart on its own.
